every approved drug on the three monoamine transporters, grouped by which it hits. the highlighted row is the ten that take dopamine and norepinephrine while leaving serotonin alone: bupropion, and otherwise the ADHD stimulant class and the appetite suppressants. the drug filed as an antidepressant has no antidepressant neighbours. counts are present-day, so they describe the era bupropion survived, not the one it entered in 1985.

the same map three times, one panel per mechanism, with all 57 approved drugs in grey and the labelled class contoured. the serotonin classes sprawl across the whole space; the ten that take dopamine and norepinephrine without serotonin sit in one corner of it. mean Tanimoto within those ten is 0.25 against 0.14 elsewhere, and no draw of ten in 5,000 reached that, p below 0.001.

cumulative registered trials by indication family. smoking passes depression in 1999 and stays ahead, 164 to 138 across the dated record, with obesity and weight arriving in 2005. the atypical mechanism is what made the second and third lives available.

the clustering, remade. the tree across the top splits the six genes into two blocks, one B-cell gene against five myeloid ones. the 200 participant rows underneath, ordered by their own tree, show no matching block. the stripe on the left marks who is on a diabetes medication.

what that participant split is worth. cutting the tree in two does enrich for medication, 2.3-fold at Fisher p = 0.015, and still misses two thirds of the people on medication while two thirds of the enriched cluster is on nothing.

the six genes with what each one is. five neutrophil and myeloid genes up, one B-cell immunoglobulin gene down, which is the shape of a change in blood cell proportions rather than a disease programme.

an adversarial autoencoder, one of the six model families the review covers. a discriminator pushes the encoder's latent codes toward a chosen prior, so sampling that prior gives the decoder valid starting points.

leaderboard: accuracy on whatever slice you have filtered to, next to the same model's accuracy on all items, with the delta and a Wilson interval. narrow the filter to a growth-specific slice and watch the order change.

contribute tab: three submission routes for clinicians, from a one-line scenario suggestion up to a full MCQ or a longitudinal vignette. everything lands in a review queue; nothing writes to the canonical dataset live.

Medicare inpatient stays in eight Stroke Belt states, drawn from the patient's home county to the hospital's county. Arcs run light at home to deep at the hospital, so each starburst is a hub the surrounding counties depend on. Rings are the 47 rural hospitals here that closed since 2010 and could be placed on the map. Open it to tilt the map, hover any arc, county or closure, and filter out small flows.

the study in one figure. 23,584 PubMed papers scored for 13 text signals; a language model and a human coder validate 169 and 50 of them; 553 papers keep a report of partnership or organization support. right panel: +70% against random PubMed papers, +28% adjusted, +8% matched; -2% against the 12,222 unflagged papers from the same search, -8% adjusted; +34% within open access for papers naming a patient organization in full text.

the whole argument in one panel. the 553 papers with a detected report sit 28% above random PubMed papers after adjustment and 8% below the 12,222 unflagged papers retrieved by the same search. the unflagged papers are themselves 52% above random. the advantage belongs to the involvement-vocabulary literature as a whole.

the citation difference by comparison group and estimator. +70% unadjusted, +54% year-reweighted, +28% in median regression, +8% under coarsened exact matching with an interval crossing zero. against the unflagged corpus it is -2% unadjusted and -8% adjusted. the number you report is a choice about the control group.

six of thirteen signals survive. precision against hand coding with Wilson intervals, 9 or 10 sampled papers each. patient author, organization as funder, organization as affiliation and collective author all reach 9 of 10 or better; self-report instruments, self-experimentation and patient-controlled data never once identified real involvement.
who said it first: days between the first patient record and the first scientific record, per symptom, 2020.

the two-stage cascade. a deterministic high-recall keyword and source-scope screen cuts 212,983 rows to 22,834, then a structured classifier that names the primary clinical subject takes that to 12,324. the orange step is the one that would have been the whole method if keywords were enough.

recall is not uniform by age band. the adult-pregnancy gate drops newborns delivered to an adult mother, so neonate recall sits at 75.4%. a validated fix exists and is shipped opt-in rather than on by default, with the gap documented and covered by a test.

the version that did not ship. Chicago tracts, 1930s HOLC redlining grade beside present-day blood-pressure medication rates. the two maps line up, which is the whole reason the question was worth asking, but too few tracts survived cleaning to support a claim, so the project moved to Stroke Belt states and dropped the layer. kept here because the abandoned approach is the part most readers would want to see.

top, how many proteins separate diabetic from non-diabetic participants under three models. the usual confounders leave the count alone; one column for metformin removes nine tenths of it. bottom, GDF15, the strongest unadjusted hit, crossing back below the significance threshold once the drug it responds to is accounted for.

left, the reward network with node size and line width scaled by STRING confidence; GLP1R sits off the cluster on a single link to tyrosine hydroxylase. right, every gene ranked by the summed confidence of its links, with GLP1R at 0.41 against 9.84 for DRD2.

the hero. Wegovy's share of reportable physician payment dollars by specialty, 2022 to 2024. endocrinology 66.6% to 33.8%, cardiovascular disease 5.3% to 28.7%. the SELECT cardiovascular indication landed in March 2024 and the recorded payment mix moved with it.
physician payments by brand. Novo raised Wegovy's spend in the same year Zepbound scaled, and let Saxenda go from $4.42M to $0.13M. defence of the new molecule, abandonment of the old one.

an illustrative walk from list price to patient cost, not an observed one. $1,349 list, then $675 net on an assumed 50% rebate, then $135 to the patient on assumed 20% coinsurance. Zepbound is lower at every step. Confidential rebates mean the middle and final numbers are scenario, not measurement.
Zepbound wins the weight-loss comparison and costs less. Wegovy holds the premium on cardiovascular risk reduction and lean-mass preservation, the claims Zepbound's label cannot make.

filed March 2006, approved June 2021, expiring December 2031 after a 1,040-day Hatch-Waxman extension. about ten and a half years of selling, cut short again by Mylan's 2025 Delaware win and its 180-day exclusivity.
